# NSPanel HAUI 0.4.3

This release brings firmware and display updates under Home Assistant control,
improves update reliability, and fixes several display, notification, and
device-management issues.

## Highlights

- **HAUI Display update entity** — installs the TFT required by the firmware,
another release version, or a custom URL. Device Manager also offers firmware
installation and an explicit update check.
- Firmware updates can be installed from the offered update, another release, or
a URL. Firmware and TFT checks run independently; a firmware update is followed
by the matching TFT after reboot.
- Update handling is more reliable: GitHub release metadata is shared in a
one-hour cache, redirect buffers fit GitHub asset URLs, failures are reported,
and manual update checks bypass the cache.
- The development config includes optional uptime and ESPHome debug diagnostics;
release firmware omits them. The universal image retains saved Wi-Fi credentials
across firmware updates.
- Fixes cover the buzzer staying on during firmware updates/reboots, GitHub TFT
redirect failures, firmware-only update checks, and navigation, grid, temperature,
and editor issues.

## Before updating

- Replace custom automations that call `esphome.<device>_upload_tft` with
`nspanel_haui.update_tft`; remove `tft_update_url_portrait`. The
`esphome.<device>_upload_tft_url` action remains available for the integration's
transport.
- Update the integration, then install matching firmware and TFT. See
[Upgrading](https://github.com/happydasch/nspanel_haui/blob/master/docs/upgrading.md#10-tft-install-actions-moved-to-the-integration)
for migration details.

## Related report

- [#62](https://github.com/happydasch/nspanel_haui/issues/62), reported by
  [@jsenecal](https://github.com/jsenecal): the original TFT-upload scenario was
  hardware-confirmed on US/portrait in 0.4.2; 0.4.3 extends buzzer suspension to
  firmware OTA and reboots. The new OTA path remains on the hardware canary list.
